purpose: Minimal self-authored fixture and result collection from an independent Linux official-Mermaid prototype; not product integration or a runnable distribution.

renderConfigurationSummary.kind: derived by reading the actual render-one.mjs harness, not an original runtime configuration file
renderConfigurationSummary.secureRule: All keys of mermaid.mermaidAPI.defaultConfig plus securityLevel, startOnLoad, maxTextSize, maxEdges, secure and htmlLabels; unique keys.
renderConfigurationSummary.notAppliedFromManifest: manifest.baseInitialize is retained as original parser-stage metadata, not passed wholesale to mermaid.initialize by the rendering harness

copyPolicy: Each entry is a byte-for-byte copy; only the containing archive path changes. Fixture manifest paths remain valid. Case ids map to rendered/<id>.png and rendered/<id>.json. No original file was rewritten.

derivedFiles.transformation: New Chinese scope and file-index summary based on listed original evidence; explicit limitations and archive-path mapping added. Not an original run artifact.

fixtureReview.review: Read all 50 small sample texts and checked for credentials, private paths and external URLs; none observed. All fixture hashes match both the original manifest and actual rendered-case results.

excluded: config/ including passwd, group and machine-id
reproductionBoundary: Original fixtures, images and result identities can be checked from this collection. Execution depends on an omitted engine, harness and Linux tools; this is not a standalone rerunnable environment and proves neither Milkup nor Windows integration.
selfHashPolicy: provenance.json cannot include its own hash; the parent generates the final collection checksum separately.
